title: Men Who Eat More Plant-Based Protein Have Higher Testosterone Levels - Nautilus
gist: A study in the International Journal of Food Sciences and Nutrition of more than 2,500 middle-aged Finnish men found higher plant-protein intake associated with higher testosterone, cutting against RFK Jr.'s meat-heavy messaging. The author flags that the data are old, collected 1984-1989 in the Kuopio Ischaemic Heart Disease Risk Factor Study.
